limitation: Posthoc exploratory controls selected after inspecting the original discovery results, on the same nine development components. These are not new confirmatory tests. Original primary comparisons and artifacts are preserved. A strong source-value comparator diagnoses decoder accessibility, not a dedicated relational representation. State-matched provenance pairs differ in an explicit source copy and do not establish natural causal use. Seeds and lexical relatives are not independent replications. No raw activation arrays, model calls, refits or sealed outcomes are used.

algebraic.seed_aggregation: Mean row correctness over three fixed fits before whole-group resampling; class denominators recomputed in every draw.

structural.seed_aggregation: Mean row correctness over three fixed fits before nine whole-group draws.

Their surface text therefore differs: success can reflect access to that copy source under the known fixed scaffold. Distinct predictions alone do not establish correct graph recovery. Lexical/numeric relatives, weighting seeds and paired rows are not independent replications; structural components are uncertainty units. These scores do not establish a dedicated relation code, general version resolution, natural causal use or arithmetic execution.
